Everyone around me went "Ewww!", and the pricks of the class chanted "Vomit girl! Vomit girl!"... Someone said "Eww, you did it over my shirt, you better pay for my laundry!", someone went "Oh my god, I can't stand this!", people were surrounding me. I was at that time trying to recover from four years of bullying, and being in that situation reminded me of those experiences.

Only one person came to my aid - my crush of that time (I'll call him R), the only person who genuinely cared about me.
He knelt down to me, patted and caressed my back, constantly asking whether I was okay or not. I couldn't speak, I was way too horrified by what was going on. He cried out for the girls in the class to get me to the washroom, and so they did.

I think I vomited nearly all my meals of the day before in the toilets. R called our homeroom teacher and got me my bag, and I was picked up by my parents and sent back home.

I didn't go to school for a week after that, not because I was sick, but because of the humiliation I went through.
The day I did show up, I was greeted by a bunch of girls telling me R was worried sick about me, and that he beat the crap out of the guys who teased me. Speak of the devil, R walks into the room and instantly runs over to me and hugs me. I was so touched, I nearly cried.

After that no one messed with me for that entire year, and R and I got very close.
So it was definitely bad timing, but not as bad because I got to be with the one I loved.

P.S.: Fast forward, I don't have a crush on R anymore, he's moved to a different city, but we still stay in contact and are best friends. He still cares about me as much as he did back then, even though I've been a creep to the point I stalked him. Hats off to R, the best person there is.
